title: Four fixes for seeking back
note: Fonts: awaited before and after every seek. A face still loading after 10 s fails the render.

steps.name: 1. Stop killing
steps.note:
Remove the global
animation: none.
Seek them instead.

steps.name: 2. Keep finished
steps.note:
fill: none ones come
back on a seek back.

steps.name: 3. Drop dead ones
steps.note:
Never re-seek a
cancelled or removed
animation.

steps.name: 4. Freeze the clock
steps.note:
Document timeline
at rate 0, so only a
seek moves anything.
